regions.label: Painted desert background with hex grid, creatures, floating health counters and 'Skipped'/name labels
Left column of four ability icon buttons with vertical health/energy meters at the edge
Right column: audio, fast-forward, hourglass/timer, fullscreen buttons with tooltip
Rounded translucent pill showing latest timestamped combat log line
Initiative queue of creature portraits with status labels and round separator
Player2 stats: points, plasma, units, game name

evidence.quote: 00:00:07 Uncle Fungus gained 18 regrowth for now

Health count pill under a creature
Status label strip under queue portraits (Protected/Sickened/Queued)
Vertical colored bars are health/energy meters, not progress of work
Multi-stat text panel, not a single-KPI tile
Log pill is persistent, replaced by the next log line rather than auto-dismissing
Turn-order queue of game units, not media; filed as new entry turn-order-queue

structure.layout: full-viewport game canvas: painted desert battlefield with hex grid in centre, ability icon column on left edge, control button column on right edge (audio, skip/fast-forward, delay timer, fullscreen), turn-order portrait queue along bottom-left, player stats panel bottom-right, single-line combat log pill above the queue

aesthetics.typography: Play (Google Fonts, squarish techno sans) for all HUD text: labels, log, tooltip, stats; floating combat text (Skipped, unit names) in game canvas styled with outlines
aesthetics.typeScale: Flat, small HUD scale: 18px log/labels, 14px status labels and tooltip body, 12px hotkey hints; emphasis via color (blue/red team names, yellow floating text) rather than size

notes: Not a website in the usual sense: an HTML5 canvas (Phaser) game screen. Painted desert backdrop with giant skeleton; black outline hex grid; team colors red (player 1) and blue (player 2) used for portrait borders, health pills and log names. Bottom-left large active-creature portrait followed by smaller queue portraits with colored status strips (gold Protected, olive Sickened, slate Queued, black Round separator). Left ability icons are embossed sandstone-toned tiles; right control buttons same. Stone/skull texture frame top and bottom. Combat text floats above units. No codebook entry for game board/HUD or turn-order queue (proposal filed: turn-order-queue). Live copy had advanced to a later game state with a music-player overlay open, so it was not used to change codes.
